query: SELECT 'org' AS "scope!", preset AS "preset!", count(*) AS "n!" FROM org_memberships WHERE org_id = $1 AND preset <> 'custom' GROUP BY preset UNION ALL SELECT 'project', x.preset, count(*) FROM ( SELECT m.preset FROM project_memberships m JOIN projects p ON p.id = m.project_id WHERE p.org_id = $1 AND m.preset <> 'custom' UNION ALL SELECT s.preset FROM service_accounts s JOIN projects p ON p.id = s.project_id WHERE p.org_id = $1 AND s.archived_at IS NULL AND s.preset <> 'custom') x GROUP BY x.preset
